description: This file defines a ProjectProvider class in Dart for Flutter, managing a list of Project objects by listening to a data repository. It provides methods for adding, updating, and deleting projects, and notifies listeners of changes.

classes.name: ProjectProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of Projects, listening to a repository for updates and providing methods to modify and notify about changes.

methods.name: ProjectProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository and UID provider, and sets up listening to project updates.

methods.name: _listen
methods.description: Sets up a stream subscription to listen for changes in the project list from the repository.

methods.name: addProject
methods.description: Adds a new project via the repository.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates an existing project via the repository.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID via the repository.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the stream subscription when the provider is disposed.
